I've been seeing a lot of doomsday-level short positions on AI infra over the past few weeks. The basic thesis: if Jensen has been propping up the price of his chips through circular financing and that unravels, we could find out the chips these neoclouds are renting out are actually worth... let's just say half of what they paid for them. If that happens, they'll be devoured by the debt they've taken on. $NBIS, for example, has $14B in debt on its balance sheet as a ~$35B company.

And it doesn't stop at Nvidia. If the market decides an H100 or Blackwell is really worth half, that resets the price for everything priced against it. Google's TPUs are priced to compete with Nvidia's current chips, so they'd get marked down too. Then it moves down the line: GPU rental rates, neocloud contracts, data center valuations, the power deals, the memory and networking suppliers. Every part of the AI stack is anchored to that one number. Pull it down and everything can violently re-rate to the downside.

Btw, this would be VERY bad news for every tech company that's taken on debt. $AMZN, $META, $GOOGL... even they'd get slaughtered (in the short term).

MICROSOFT TO USE $INTC'S EMIB PACKAGING FOR AZURE CHIPS

$MSFT is the FIRST company to announce plans to use Intel Foundry's EMIB advanced packaging for its own Azure silicon. 

EMIB connects multiple chiplets within a single package, allowing more flexible chip designs.

The new long-term agreement with Intel also secures multi-year Xeon CPU supply for Azure, including next-gen Diamond Rapids processors.

The companies will also expand work on CXL memory, Intel QuickAssist acceleration and TDX confidential computing, including encryption of VM memory and CPU state during host migrations.

Intel says its existing Azure optimizations deliver:

- Up to 2.3x greater performance and memory flexibility in Azure M-series v4 VMs using Xeon 6 and CXL memory.

- Up to 2.5x faster SQL backups through QuickAssist-enabled Azure VMs.

text:
$NVDA If you are wondering why the stock is down today despite reporting a beat and raise quarter here is my 2 cents. 

✅They didn’t file their 10q at the same time as earnings release as was their custom. Red Flag 🚩 

✅The call and Q&A didn’t address investor concerns. They claimed zero sales to China. That is laughable. 

✅After call very large holders of stock get to talk to management. They ask tougher questions than sell side. Collectively they likely didn’t like the answers or legal speak non answers. In short they don’t believe the future guidance is real. The pop in the morning was sold and continues as of this post. This is called a long squeeze…opposite of short squeeze. 

Bottom line: The market is worried that the former CFO and Board are in CYA mode on the China question and reported Jensen’s numbers and guidance but didn’t file 10q and sign off on them legally yet. Speculation is that they will open the kimono on China numbers after an investigation and pretend they didn’t know. 

Additionally the other problems for the stock are: 

-competition will take advantage of leadership disruption and gross margins will eventually go lower. 
-Neo clouds are having trouble getting financing to buy more chips. 
-The DSOs of receivables went to 64 from 60 last Q and 45 prior. Customers are taking longer to pay essentially. 
-SEC investigation and DOJ investigation overhang
-And finally macro concerns that the credit markets are questioning the build out of AI and the cycle

Buy Financials

zh_summary: @tig88411109分析$NVDA最新Q3財務數據及下一季預測全面超預期，粉碎空頭關於半導體算力週期見頂及估值塌陷的論點。強調真正護城河在頂級技術路線及工程實現能力，Rubin第一季確認200億訂單，部署效率較上一代快一倍，token/瓦效率為Blackwell的十倍，意味1GW的Rubin年收入400-500億。系統工程包括自有CPU/連接/安全芯片及明年光互連CPO。收入多元化超越雲端大廠，扶持新雲、企業及主權。證偽表外擔憂：6400億承諾近4000億為供應鏈鎖定晶圓/HBM/封裝，1000億自用雲，320億新雲有條件，OpenAI 20年獨家。儘管黃仁勳離職有短期影響，基本面強勁，估值溢價需調整至中長期合理區間，事件性買入時點。
en_summary: @tig88411109 analyzes $NVDA latest Q3 financials and next quarter guidance fully beat expectations, crushing the bear thesis of semiconductor compute cycle peaking and valuation collapse. Highlights true moat in top-tier tech roadmap and engineering, Rubin first quarter $20B orders confirmed with 1 month deployment efficiency double previous and 10x token/watt vs Blackwell, implying 1GW Rubin revenue $40-50B per year. System engineering with own CPU/connect/security chips and CPO next year. Diversified revenue beyond cloud, supporting neoclouds, enterprises, sovereign. Refutes off-balance sheet concerns: $640B commitments mostly supply chain locks for wafers/HBM/packaging, $100B own cloud, $32B neocloud with conditions, OpenAI 20-year exclusive. Despite Huang exit short-term impact, fundamentals strong, valuation premium needs adjustment to long-term reasonable, event-driven buy points.
text:
$NVDA 最新Q3财报财务数据和下一季预测全面超预期，粉碎的是空头的“半导体算力周期见顶和估值塌陷”的小作文陷阱。  

一个人能活成黄仁勋这种离职能带崩2万亿自己创业公司市值，还能带崩整个AI泡沫，那真是可以笑傲江湖了。如何真正的解读背后事件以及财报中关键的英伟达投资策略“范式”转移？

真正的行业专家背景买方投资看的当然不只是一个收入和毛利超预期，这都是大概率。要看到这种英伟达顶级的技术路线和工程实现能力，这才是真正的护城河

8月启动发售新一代Rubin第一个季度就200亿订单确认，部署效率1个月比上一代快一倍，而且新一代的token/瓦的效率是上一代Blackwell的十倍提升，意味着1GW的Rubin收入就是一年4-500亿。

这不是简单卖GPU，而是真正的系统工程，自己的CPU/连接/安全芯片/明年上光互连CPO量产又一能效提升。加上模块化工厂，按上接点就挣钱。这个背景就是大的行业需求暴涨，特别是Agentic AI对于算力需求，哪怕老卡早期前2代的租金都在大涨。

收入多元化除了云大厂占1半，这也是为什么英伟达要扶持第三方新云公司，包括企业/主权等收入，降低依赖于单一大客户风险，何况中国收入为0，目前北美/欧日等需求直接填补空档，供不应求。

哪怕是市场担心的表外担保生态融资，来虚增收入，完全可以证伪。6400亿表外承诺，近4000亿是供应链采购承诺主要是锁定上游晶圆/HBM存储和封装产能，这是必须的，因为英伟达自己是轻资产，对于上游的供应链掌控重要性。当然老黄不在有短期影响，但对于英伟达这种体量客户，靠个人关系已经不是长久之计，必然规范大势所趋，这方面何况作为最大的客户，英伟达是甲方，不担心台湾供应链不保障的风险

另外1000亿是自用云服务；真正新云neocloud保底租赁也就是320亿，而且都是有明确前置条件，就是全部上线才担保，现在供不应求之下，风险何在？另外1000多亿是OpenAI的20年独家租约，至少目前看不到证伪。

目前市场大跌因为黄仁勋的时代落幕，当然作为创始人的远见和个人魄力是有折价，这主要体现在可能未来3-5年战略的选择，但是对于AI时代真正的王者和领头羊，老黄一人独裁的邪修管理风格，也是必然在企业进入系统化竞争的平台后，管理范式的转移，向“开宗立派”转移，只不过，他个人事件离职，加速了这个转移而已。

从投资策略和估值角度，事件性冲击短期当然是重点，根据不同的事件会有好的买入时点，结合合理的估值，因为基本面虽然强，但是整体的估值溢价需要下调到一个中长期合理的区间，同时也要考虑本质性，一些竞争力丧失的风险，比如法律和治理风险，人才流失风险。

颗粒度更细的投资策略和估值，见订阅者专享。教育分享。

zh_summary: @KevInvestingYT列出負面因素：$NVDA執行長（執行循環融資劇本）辭職。幾天後SEC開始調查其披露並延遲10-Q。Nvidia正被三個政府機構調查：SEC、DOJ及商務部。每天都有新報告將Nvidia與芯片流入中國聯繫。今天The Information稱Nvidia介紹阿里巴巴給Alice Huang以規避美國出口管制。Muddy Waters現在做空。一些分析師認為半導體接近週期高峰。TPU及定制芯片正在搶佔$NVDA的AI芯片市場份額。利率上升，因此除了對抗DOJ、SEC及商務部，你還在對抗聯儲局。我漏了什麼？在什麼世界裡有人想做多$NVDA？
en_summary: @KevInvestingYT lists negatives: $NVDA CEO who ran the circular-financing playbook resigns. Days later SEC opens probe into disclosures and they delay the 10-Q. Nvidia investigated by 3 agencies: SEC, DOJ, Commerce Department. Every day new report tying Nvidia to chips reaching China. Today The Information says Nvidia introduced Alibaba to Alice Huang to work around U.S. export controls. Muddy Waters is now short. Semis nearing cyclical peak according to some analysts. TPUs and custom chips stealing $NVDA’s AI chip market share. Rates are increasing so on top of fighting DOJ SEC and Commerce you are also fighting the Fed. What am I missing? In what world would anyone want to be long $NVDA?
text:
- $NVDA CEO who ran the circular-financing playbook resigns.

- Days later, the SEC opens a probe into their disclosures and they delay the 10-Q.

- Nvidia is now being investigated by 3 different government agencies: the SEC, the DOJ, and the Commerce Department.

- Every day there’s a new report tying Nvidia to chips reaching China. Today The Information says Nvidia introduced Alibaba to Alice Huang to work around U.S. export controls. Muddy Waters is now short.

- Semis are nearing their cyclical peak, according to some analysts.

- TPUs and custom chips are stealing $NVDA’s AI chip market share.

- Rates are increasing, SO ON TOP OF FIGHTING THE DOJ, THE SEC, AND THE COMMERCE DEPARTMENT, YOU ARE ALSO FIGHTING THE FED.

What am I missing? In what world would anyone want to be long $NVDA?
